The manager of the reptile department should be fired and I have reported this store to Petco's corporate for animal abuse and neglect. The cashier and Manager on Duty were unable/unwilling to give me the name of the person who manages the reptile department.

Multiple animals were severely malnourished, dehydrated, injured, and left in filthy enclosures filled with feces. One crested gecko was clearly severely ill, struggling to breathe, malnourished and in need of emergency veterinary care. Ball pythons were hiding, dull and all in shed, living in feces. Bearded dragons were dehydrated, the babies had no water in a long-dried-out dish, showed signs of calcium deficiency, injured tails, and were missing toes. I'm not well versed in turtles but the red ear sliders were pale, their tank was grody and their light sources seemed too small and too far away, not enough uvb. Live feeder insects were sitting on store shelves for too long: they were dead, discolored and rotting in their containers, there was a mild odor as you got close. These conditions were disgusting and inhumane, and this store should be ashamed of itself.

I feel like she takes her time to explain things to us and has recommended a lot of things (treats, toys, etc) that have helped my husband and I with our new puppy. Highly recommend this location and I highly recommend Michelle to train your furry friends.  Also, here’s a picture of my pup after a grooming session at that Petco as well .
